observation: Read all 1982 characters. The opening turns bath comfort into two criteria, overall temperature and uniformity. A dimensional simplification leads to three explicitly differentiated models: steady-state thermodynamics supplies constants to subsequent models, Fourier analysis supplies an analytical distribution, and finite differences model bulk motion and diffusion. The comparison paragraph chooses the numerical model on the stated dominance of convection, then hands its outputs to PID control and inlet placement. The conclusion returns to the original temperature/uniformity/water objectives. This is a model-role and comparison-to-control chain, not simply a list of algorithms. No numerical optimum or measured improvement margin appears here, and physical/model correctness has not been checked. Discretionary breaks in 'how- ever' and 'deriv- ing' still interrupt author prose and require source-bound literal restoration; no claim of source-complete fidelity.
